planets.name: EPIC 206215704 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 206215704 with a 2.26-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: EPIC 206215704 b was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 206215704. Its orbit and size follow Adams et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
